fichas.title: Office Buildings: Additional Areas
fichas.summary: Guidance on planning entrance and access-control zones, conference and training facilities, post rooms, archives, IT and social areas, toilets, cleaning services, and other workplace support spaces. The page provides space allowances per workstation and design considerations for access, circulation, storage, noise reduction, and building services.

dimensions.label: Total space requirement per workstation
dimensions.context: Overall space requirement varies with organisational and status requirements.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The total space requirement per workstation varies between 23 and 45 m2

dimensions.label: Basement car parking area included in total
dimensions.context: Included in the stated total space requirement; not included in the floor-to-space ratio.
dimensions.ocr_raw: This includes 2.6 m² car parking area in the basement, which is not included in the floor to space ratio.

dimensions.label: Subsidiary rooms for conference catering
dimensions.context: About one third of the conference area; subsidiary rooms include store rooms and a pantry for catering.
dimensions.ocr_raw: these subsidiary rooms require about Vs of the conference area

dimensions.label: Conference area per seat
dimensions.context: Conference area allowance excluding subsidiary areas.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A conference area requires about 2.5 m² per seat (without subsidiary areas).

dimensions.label: Conference and training space requirement
dimensions.context: Space requirement stated for conference and training.

dimensions.label: Post room space requirement
dimensions.context: Space allowance per post-room work position.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Space requirement - 0.3-0.5 m2 per work position.

dimensions.label: Paper archive space occupied
dimensions.context: Purely paper archives rapidly take up this space; the supplied OCR reads “m” and the page image indicates square metres.
dimensions.ocr_raw: purely paper archives rapidly take up 10-20 m per workstation

dimensions.label: Archive floor loading
dimensions.context: Increased floor loading recommended for archive rooms with mobile units.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Archive rooms should be designed for an increased floor loading of 7.5-12.5 kN/m 2 (for mobile units)

dimensions.label: Raised floor height in IT rooms
dimensions.context: Recommended raised floor for extensive installations in server rooms or data centres.
dimensions.ocr_raw: These rooms should have a 70 em raised floor on account of the large amount of installation

dimensions.label: Tea kitchen provision
dimensions.context: Approximately one kitchen for every stated number of workplaces; kitchen area is approximately 10 m².
dimensions.ocr_raw: For every approx. 50-1 00 workplaces, one -10 m2 kitchen.

dimensions.label: Tea kitchen area
dimensions.context: Approximate area for one tea kitchen serving approximately 50–100 workplaces.

dimensions.label: Toilet unit provision
dimensions.context: A good ratio is one toilet unit per stated number of workstations.
dimensions.ocr_raw: A good ratio is one toilet unit per 50-80 workstations.
